GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv.reason: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw. node-forge only reaches the app through Para (@getpara/core-sdk), which uses it for RSA/AES encryption, key generation and randomness, never to verify RSA signatures; the app itself does not use it. No fixed node-forge release exists yet.

GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5.reason: Memory exhaustion when a zod array schema without a length bound validates a huge attacker-supplied array. zod 3.25 reaches the app only through Para (@getpara/shared validates Para's own API responses) and abitype via viem (an optional peer that parses the app's own ABI definitions); the app has no zod schema and never validates user input with one. The fix is zod 4.6.6, but Para requires zod ^3 and no 3.x release carries it.
